Add this Grok Bot. No signup, no API key.

Drop a document eg financial statement. OCR is free to start. You get the financials back as Excel. Then a cited memo. You sign.

Same document job as Reducto, inside Grok, plus the analyst.https://t.co/JlnEXCs7cg
